notes: Child-specific notices (slice 2). The listener check names the child and nothing else; everything specific is said only after the parent presses 1.
Gender-neutral about the child: the child's name is never followed by a gendered verb (हाज़िरी नहीं लगी है, ने ... काम किया है). The listener is addressed as आप with plural/honorific verbs.
A1, A3 and A4 share one wording on purpose, and none states a concern.
Keypad keys are words (एक, दो, नौ), not digits, so the render is deterministic.
